name: Marie-France Marcotte
bio: Marie-France Marcotte (born October 18, 1962) is a Québec actress.

credits.title: Labrador – Autopsy of Silence
credits.overview: In the icy waters of Labrador, in Canada's Arctic north, a cargo ship races to deliver the last supply run of the season to the region's isolated communities – until the murder of a crew member shatters the fragile balance of the voyage.

credits.title: My Son Came Back to Disappear
credits.overview: After years apart, a woman living alone in the forest is troubled by the sudden return of her estranged son. Against her will, she must accompany him on his final journey.

credits.title: Winkie
credits.overview: When he discovers a young orphan girl in the middle of the forest, Winkie, a violent but caring monster, decides to raise the child in his own image while protecting her from the dangers of the outside world.
